stories.title: Wall Street Rebounds After Fed's First Rate Hike in Years as Oil, Yields Dip
stories.summary: Stocks rebounded on Wall Street the day after the Federal Reserve raised interest rates for the first time in years, per Investing.com. Oil prices and Treasury yields both fell as the rally took hold. Details on the size of the hike and sector moves were not specified in the report.
stories.whyItMatters: A first rate hike in years marks a turning point in Fed policy that reshapes borrowing costs and equity valuations across the market.
whatToWatch: Whether the rebound holds into the next trading session
Further Fed commentary on the path of future rate moves
Continued direction of oil prices and Treasury yields
questions: What data or conditions drove the Fed to hike now?
Is this the start of a sustained tightening cycle?
